Westwood Computer Science Club
Beginner Friendly Machine Learning/AI Open Ended

Who Are We?

Westwood Computer Science Club is located at Westwood High School in Austin, Texas. We've won the Spike App Prediction Competition hosted by Harvard students and generated millions of views on our Instagram reels and posts.

Hackathon Tracks

This hackathon is split into two tracks: hackathon and ideathon.

Participants who select the hackathon track are required to submit a project involving code related to the hackathon theme.   

Participants who select the ideathon track are not required to submit a project involving code. Instead, you will be tasked with conceptually developing a solution to the given theme.

Theme

Create a project that solves an issue in your community, county, state, or nation.

Quick Links

  • WarriorHacks 2.0 Site
  • Westwood CS Club Discord
  • Westwood CS Club Instagram

Requirements

What to Submit

Hackathon: Please submit a GitHub repository, a 2-3 minute demo video, and pictures of your project. If your project is a website, we recommend submitting a demo link as well. 

Ideathon: Please submit any presentations, flowcharts, Figma designs, or other materials that may be helpful for presenting the project idea, as well as a 2-3 minute presentation video.

REQUIRED FOR BOTH TRACKS: Please fill out the WarriorHacks 2.0 Track Selection Form.

Judging Criteria

  • Impact
    Addresses a meaningful problem; clear audience & value.
  • Feasibility
    Technically achievable and sustainable.
  • User Experience
    Accessible, intuitive, and user‑friendly.
  • Technical Craft
    Architecture, code quality, originality, innovation.
